_notes: Castle battle (docs/specs/SPEC-castle-battle.md). grid: board size in tiles [w, h]. path: one axis-aligned polyline in tiles through tile centres, from the left castle (side 0) to the right castle (side 1); both sides walk it in opposite directions. Distances on the path are measured from side 0's castle; side 1 uses length - d. forts.atPct: fort positions as % of path length. summonBasePct: how far (% of path) a side may summon before it holds a fort; summonGapTiles: the summon zone also stops this far short of the nearest enemy unit. mana: start/max, regenSec is one point every everySec while the match clock is in [fromSec, toSec). sizes: mana cost band [min, max] per size and perMatch = times EACH card of that size may be summoned in one match (null = unlimited). moves: walking speed in tiles/s per move role. meleeRange: range in tiles of units whose range is 0 or below it. supportHeal: HP a support unit heals per hit on the most-hurt ally in range; supportGapTiles: how far it stays behind the front ally. critPct: chance a metal-kit unit hits for double. dot: burn and poison (fire-sect / wood-sect units), ticking every 0.5 s. fort: hp, dmg per shot, rate shots/s, range and captureRadius in tiles, captureSec = time a capture unit must hold a neutral fort with no enemy on it. castle: same shape; art = the castle's one-per-match bell (stuns every enemy in our half of the path for stunSec). matchSec: match length; ties are broken in spec section 7 order.
